integrity: No external validation or publication is claimed. Computational tests support but do not replace the analytical proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to unweighted complete bipartite graphs with exactly one cross-part edge removed, both parts of size at least two and at least five total vertices. It does not treat multiple deletions or arbitrary weights. Independent priority and proof validation have not been performed.
title: Sharp Hilbert-snowflake thresholds for one-edge-deleted bicliques
